tagline: Istanbul's financial and corporate centre — gleaming towers, international HQs, and the best-connected business address on the European side.

items.name: Starbucks / Kahve Dünyası (Levent AVM)
items.description: Multiple reliable café chains in and around Kanyon and Metrocity shopping centres. Practical for business meetings.

items.name: Nişantaşı & Etiler Cafés (10-min taxi)
items.description: For a proper café experience, Nişantaşı and Etiler are a short taxi ride from Levent and vastly better for working or relaxed meetings.

items.name: Kanyon AVM Restaurants
items.description: The striking Kanyon shopping centre has a good range of restaurants across price points. The outdoor amphitheatre seating is excellent in good weather.

items.name: Levent İş Merkezi Lokantalari
items.description: The side streets around the business district have solid lunch options catering to office workers. Reliable and fast.

items.name: Kanyon Shopping Centre
items.description: One of Istanbul's architecturally striking malls — an open-air canyon design with premium retail and dining across multiple levels.

items.name: İstanbul Modern (temporary — now Karaköy)
items.description: Turkey's leading contemporary art museum relocated to Karaköy. Worth combining a Levent visit with a trip there.

tips: Levent is on the M2 metro line — direct to Şişli, Taksim, and the city centre.
Primarily a business district — better for meetings than leisure. Kanyon is the exception.
For nightlife and dining, nearby Etiler and Nişantaşı are significantly better options.
The financial towers (İş Kuleleri) are an orientation landmark for the whole northern European side.
